# Digi Web Tech

> Full-service digital marketing, Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI Optimization (AIO), and web development agency driving measurable organic traffic, search visibility, and revenue growth.

Digi Web Tech is a performance-driven digital agency based in Delhi NCR, India, serving global clients across healthcare, e-commerce, real estate, education, technology, and automotive sectors. The agency specializes in modern organic growth strategies—combining traditional technical SEO with cutting-edge Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Artificial Intelligence Optimization (AIO) to secure brand citations in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google Gemini alongside traditional search engine rankings.

## Terminology Used On This Site

- **SEO (Search Engine Optimization)**: Earning ranked positions in conventional search results. Measured in rankings, clicks, and organic sessions.
- **AIO (AI Optimization)**: Making a website's own pages machine-readable -- entities, schema, answer-first structure -- so AI systems can parse what the business does. Measured in extraction accuracy.
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)**: Earning citations inside AI-generated answers on ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Copilot. Measured in citation share across AI answers and referral traffic from AI surfaces. On this site GEO always means Generative Engine Optimization, never geographic or local SEO.
